about: The official mods (1.5, docs/MODS.md 6c): the Mode choices every game offers first, in this order. "standard" is the game without a mod; every other key is src/mods/<key>.tmod.js. The server serves this list with the ids of these files, or the newer ones its admin set (POST /api/mods/official) - a fixed mode needs no new release. "gallery": the game's other example mods - not official: the server puts them into its mod gallery (by Norko) when it starts, a newer file in place of the older.
